newsitem.title: UK: Pearson up as bid talk lifts M&G.
newsitem.headline: Pearson up as bid talk lifts M&G.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc rose on Wednesday as renewed bid speculation lifted fund manager M&G, which was seen as positive for any plans Pearson may have to cash in its stake in investment bank Lazard, dealers said.

Dealers also said there was talk that NatWest had upgraded its stance on Pearson, though market sources said that while the brokerage remained positive on Pearson it had not made any comment on the stock today.
Pearson was up 15-1/2p at 769 at one stage but pared its gain to be up 6-1/2p by 0914 GMT. M&G was up 17-1/2p at 13.50 stg.
Recent press reports renewed market talk that recently-appointed chief executive Marjorie Scardino may sell off Pearson's stake in Lazard.
Additionally, Lazard was said to be looking to sell its stake in Pearson.
